name: Keyed-Alike Service Keys
description: Many commercial and institutional properties use keyed-alike master key systems from major manufacturers for utility rooms, electrical panels, elevators, and mechanical spaces. Hooligan Keys produces a set of commonly used service keys that work on these keyed-alike locks across many unrelated properties. Carrying the appropriate service key for a target's building type can open mechanical rooms, utility corridors, and rooftop access doors without any bypass or picking.

blue.det: Difficult to detect — operator presents a legitimate-looking key; access logs show valid access with no anomaly.
blue.cm: Avoid keyed-alike systems from commodity vendors; use restricted or patented keyways; key control and audit procedures; prefer electronic access for high-security areas.
